scope_note: SCOPE-completeness spine for ai-agent-tool, mined via the feature-surface lens from the FEATURE surface of ['AstrBot', 'ChatGPT-Telegram-Bot', 'LangBot', 'nekro-agent']. Complements the robustness spine (cluster_fixes.py). Does NOT predict project-specific product direction — that is strategy, not completeness.

required.what: Connect agents to IM/chat platforms such as Telegram, Slack, Discord, WeChat/WeCom/Feishu/Lark/DingTalk/QQ/Matrix/email via adapters.
required.day1_tell: Open the adapter/integrations settings and confirm at least one IM/chat adapter such as Slack, Telegram, Discord, WeChat/Feishu/Lark, Matrix, or email can be configured.

required.what: User-facing QR-code, one-click app creation, login/session handling, or multi-instance setup for chat adapters.
required.day1_tell: Start adding a chat adapter and confirm the onboarding flow provides QR login, one-click app creation, session login, or multi-instance setup.

required.what: Configure, scan, select, and display models/providers, including OpenAI-compatible APIs and provider-specific presets/capabilities.
required.day1_tell: Open model/provider settings, add or view an OpenAI-compatible provider, scan/list available models, and switch the selected model.

required.what: Expose bot commands and user-invoked actions, including command registration, naming, permissions, and rich command output.
required.day1_tell: Open the bot command/action configuration and confirm commands can be registered with names and invoked by a user to produce command output.

required.what: Manage access control for tools, commands, or function calls at user/group/admin level.
required.day1_tell: Open tool or command permissions and confirm access can be granted or denied by user, group, or admin role.

required.what: Install, browse, render, or manage plugins/extensions, including plugin pages, sidebars, cards, and marketplace metadata.
required.day1_tell: Open the plugin/extensions area and confirm plugins can be browsed or installed with visible cards, pages, or marketplace metadata.

required.what: Allow plugins/extensions to contribute web pages or iframe-rendered UI inside the admin console.
required.day1_tell: Install or open a plugin and confirm it contributes an embedded page or iframe-rendered UI inside the admin console.

required.what: Provide a web console for configuration, navigation, runtime visibility, account settings, and operational controls.
required.day1_tell: Open the web admin console and confirm it provides navigation for configuration, runtime/status visibility, account settings, or operational controls.

required.what: Support dashboard login, password setup/change, 2FA, account center, or authenticated internal APIs.
required.day1_tell: Log into the dashboard and confirm it supports authenticated access plus password setup/change, 2FA, account center, or protected internal APIs.

required.what: Ingest documents for retrieval, chunking, validation, vector search, or document question-answering.
required.day1_tell: Upload a document to the knowledge base and confirm it is ingested for chunking, validation, vector search, or document QA.

required.what: Maintain, compress, recall, rebuild, or expose conversational memory and context state.
required.day1_tell: Run a multi-turn chat, then inspect memory/context controls and confirm conversation state can be recalled, compressed, rebuilt, or displayed.

required.what: Run agent tasks in sandboxed or workspace runtimes with session lifecycle, timeout, and runtime-state visibility.
required.day1_tell: Start an agent task and confirm it runs inside a sandbox/workspace runtime with visible session lifecycle, timeout, or runtime state.

required.what: Stream AI/search responses or markdown output smoothly to the user interface or chat surface.
required.day1_tell: Send a prompt and confirm the response streams incrementally to the web UI or chat surface instead of appearing only after completion.

required.what: Parse, normalize, display, and send rich message chains including media, cards, JSON messages, mentions, images, and markdown.
required.day1_tell: Send or receive a rich message containing an image, mention, card, markdown, media, or JSON payload and confirm it is parsed and displayed correctly.

required.what: Expose multilingual README/UI/localized messages across supported languages.
required.day1_tell: Switch the UI language or open localized docs/messages and confirm multiple languages are available.

required.what: Improve sidebar/menu routing, document titles, icons, themes, auto-scroll, direct access buttons, and visual separators.
required.day1_tell: Use the UI navigation and confirm it includes personalization or navigation aids such as themes, icons, sidebar routing, document titles, auto-scroll, direct access buttons, or visual separators.

required.what: Support Docker/env-based setup, initial passwords from environment, auto-deploy, and configurable runtime options.
required.day1_tell: Deploy from Docker or environment configuration and confirm initial password, runtime options, or auto-deploy behavior can be controlled via environment variables.

optional.what: Use web/search engines or search-enabled GPT flows to answer with external information.
optional.day1_tell: Ask a question requiring current external information and confirm the product uses a web/search engine or search-enabled GPT flow in the answer.

optional.what: Manage chat channels, channel detail pages, observer modes, deletion/preview flows, and per-channel navigation.
optional.day1_tell: Open channel management and confirm chat channels have detail pages or controls for observer mode, deletion, preview, or per-channel navigation.

optional.what: Provide agent workspaces with overview tabs, resource centers, prompt composition, memory state, and running status.
optional.day1_tell: Open an agent workspace and confirm it shows overview tabs, resource center, prompt composition, memory state, or running status.
